verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 for an llms.txt at support.relayfi.com, and its content describes Relay's banking features in the llms.txt format, so an agent can be pointed at it. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation announcing or describing the llms.txt or other agent-oriented docs, unknown depth and coverage of the file (only a truncated header was observed), and no independent corroboration of its usefulness for agents.
